description: List the interactive elements of an HTML page with stable CSS selectors — Reduces an HTML document to the elements an agent can act on: links with href, buttons, inputs (not type=hidden), selects, textareas, [role], [onclick], contenteditable, each with tag, type, role, best-effort accessible name (including label associations) and a CSS selector that matches exactly that element, preferring a stable id, then a data-testid-style attribute, name, aria-label, then a struc

dedupe.description: Collapse elements with identical tag, type, role, name and href. Default true.

name: dom-skeleton
